description:
Single-use and multi-use codes, percentage/fixed discounts, comps, redemption limits and windows.

**Conditions of Success:**
- Single-use codes are single-use under concurrent redemption attempts
- Multi-use codes enforce max-redemption and validity windows
- Discounts compose correctly with fees and appear in the journal breakdown

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map).
